acceptance.given: A disposable inspection root containing the actual standard, policy and schema bytes, with capability declarations classified as database capabilities and variants that identify, omit or explicitly disclaim a required database/backup system.

oracle.expected: The normative declaration contract requires every database-classified capability to identify a required database/backup system. A declaration identifying that requirement satisfies this specific check; omission or an explicit claim that no database/backup system is required produces a structured validation failure with the applicable rule identifier, diagnostic code and declaration path.
forbidden: A database-classified capability is compliant while declaring that no database/backup system is required.
A missing database/backup system requirement is silently accepted.
A passing runtime result substitutes for inspecting the normative declaration requirement.
Static declaration validation is represented as a completed backup or restore drill.

During the same targeted case, direct calls to scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package inspect structured outcomes for explicit-system, missing-system and no-system variants.
